title: Soft landscaping minimum 15% of the site
text: C1.2.1 Development to provide a minimum 15% soft landscaping per site with a minimum dimension of 1m (refer Figure 1.2a). C1.2.4 The soft landscaping percentage of C1.2.1 may be reduced to 10% where a significant existing tree is retained on site. Note: a retained tree replaces the tree planting provision in C1.2.4 on a like-for-like basis.

exceptions.label: C1.2.4 significant existing tree retained on site: soft landscaping reduced to 10%

replaces.note: no site-wide soft landscaping requirement at R40 and below in Part B
tree-retention reduction to 10%; new for R2-R40 (ch2-012)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: C1.2.4 is on page 12; its note cites C1.2.4 where C1.2.3 is meant (drafting error, no effect on values).

notes: Soft landscape per the A1 definition (min 300 mm soil depth, in-ground planting, turf included; excludes permeable paving and planter boxes). C1.2.4 is an exception, not a rule (a concession not taken must not fail the element). C1.2.4 note: a retained tree replaces the tree planting provision 'in C1.2.4' like-for-like; the planting provision is actually C1.2.3 (cross-reference error, ch2-012). R100-SL: C1.2.1-r100sl.
